method.accuracy: correct / all selected cases, errors count as incorrect
method.coverage: macro mean over non-abstention cases with gold_pairs > 0
method.latency: NumPy linear percentiles; response wall time includes invoker retry waits; not system speed ratio
method.usage: completed recorded responses only; not a total account bill
method.cohort_scope: question-ID disjoint 36+24+12, histories may overlap; diagnostic and Mem0 reuse cases

matched_mem0_12.note: same 12 question IDs, 9 non-abstention, 3 abstention; extracted facts vs complete pairs

holdout24.scope: 4 case workers, cached vectors, query repeat=5, ingest excludes common source preparation

fresh12.scope: 4 case workers, cached vectors, query repeat=5, ingest excludes common source preparation

mem0_index.scope: Mem0 init+LLM additive extraction+local embedding+dedup/storage in ingest; query includes local BGE inference; up to 4 workers
